summary: Verified BUG-FIX for AccessorySales 'Failed to record sale' end-to-end. (1) Backend curl reproduction confirmed: POST /api/accessory-sales for 'Domestic Regulator' qty=1 unit_price=500 (the exact regex-collision case from iteration_55) now returns HTTP 200 with the persisted sale (gt=500.0). Multi-line sale (2x Domestic Regulator @350.5 + 1x Commercial Regulator @1200) returns 200 with gt=1901.0. (2) validate_sale_discrepancy('accessory_sale') in /app/backend/routes/gst_billing.py L498-503 now early-returns discrepancy_payload(None, actual) — confirmed via code inspection. (3) /app/backend/routes/accessories.py L536-539 no longer calls validate_sale_discrepancy before insert — confirmed. (4) AccessorySales.jsx handleSubmit catch block now extracts detail (string | {message} | pydantic-array[0].msg) — confirmed at L233-242. (5) Backend regression: ran test_invoice_memo_payment_ledger.py + test_discrepancy_invoices.py + test_discrepancy_extras.py + test_gst_billing.py = 46 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed (no regression to sales_entry discrepancy or manual GST-invoice discrepancy flows). (6) Frontend: admin login → /accessory-sales page loads, summary cards render (Total Sales 3 / Total Amount ₹1,120 / Items Sold 3 / Pending ₹0), New Sale Entry dialog opens with all fields (data-testid=add-sale-btn), customer mode toggle works, accessory dropdown shows 4 active accessories, unit_price input accepts dealer-set price, client-side validation toast 'Please select accessories and enter valid quantities' surfaces correctly when item fields incomplete. Listed sales include the previously-created BUG_FIX_VERIFY entry (Domestic Regulator x1 ₹500 cash) proving the API-created sale renders. (7) Backend curl with empty items array currently returns 200 (no backend min-items validator); frontend already guards this client-side so user never hits it.

minor.issue: Accepts items=[] and persists a sale with grand_total=0 (no min-length validator on AccessorySaleCreate.items). Frontend blocks this case, so no user impact. Consider adding a pydantic Field(min_length=1) on items for defense-in-depth.

context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG IS FIXED. The original reproduction (Domestic Regulator @ dealer price ≠ unrelated gst_items 'Regulator' default_rate 247.69) no longer triggers a 400. Connection-sale discrepancy flow (sales_entry) untouched — 46 GST/discrepancy regression tests still pass. Note: test_sales_accessory_integration.py has 2 stale assertions (paginated dict vs list, missing refills sub-key) unrelated to this fix; main agent may want to refresh those.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (iteration_55 regression): validate_sale_discrepancy() did a name-prefix regex on db.gst_items for accessory_sale, matching accessories like 'Domestic Regulator' against an unrelated gst_items master row 'Regulator' (default_rate ₹247.69). Dealer-set sale price ₹500 differed from that ₹247.69 → server returned 400 {code:'discrepancy_requires_reason', expected_amount:247.69}. AccessorySales.jsx caught the error but discarded the detail and showed a generic toast. FIX: (a) gst_billing.validate_sale_discrepancy early-returns is_discrepancy=False for sale_type='accessory_sale' since accessories have no fixed master rate; (b) accessories.py removed the pre-insert discrepancy gate; (c) AccessorySales.jsx error toast now extracts detail.message / detail string / pydantic ValidationError[0].msg. VERIFICATION: (i) Direct curl POST /api/accessory-sales for the exact failing payload now returns 200. (ii) 46-test GST+discrepancy regression suite green. (iii) UI page loads, dialog form & validation work. MITIGATION (if recurs): ensure validate_sale_discrepancy's accessory_sale branch never re-introduces gst_items lookups; accessories must always pass through without discrepancy gating.
